tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250ye shes rab 'bar gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ 1$0000300hrīḥ 'og min bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas// 'dus pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan snang mtha' yas// chos sku'i 'khor tshogs bcas la gsol ba 'debs// ka dag chos sku'i dgongs pa'i dngos grub stsol// rang bzhin ma 'dres gsal snang longs spyod rdzogs// tshe dang ye shes dpag med gar gyi dbang*// sems dpa' tshe bdag bcas la gsol ba 'debs// lhun grub 'chi med longs sku'i dngos grub stsol// gang 'dul mdzad pa nam mkhas gar khyab kyi// phrin las sna tshogs sprul bsgyur pad+ma 'byung*// zhi khro'i gar bsgyur gtso la gsol ba 'debs// zhi rgyas dbang drag mthu stobs dngos grub stsol// sku gsum ston pa gsang chen ye shes bcud// bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad pa'i ḍā ki ma// bde chen rgya mtsho'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bde stong zung 'jug bcud kyi dngos grub stsol// rje 'bangs dbus na gzigs pa'i lo tsā ba// ya mtshan chos rnams bka' babs rjes gnang ba'i// dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// zab rgya'i bcud rnams ma lus dngos grub stsol// o rgyan chen pos smon lam gtad rgya'i mthus// grangs med zab chos spyod pa'i chos rgyal che// gter bdag sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// yongs rdzogs gsang sngags bcud 'dus dngos grub stsol// smon lam dbang gis gsang sngags dkyil 'khor du// 'jug pa gcig pa'i 'dzin spel gang 'dul gyi// bka' babs chos bdag rnams la gsol ba 'debs// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba 'dren pa'i dngos grub stsol// gsang sngags rgyud lung man ngag snying po yi// rim gnyis dkyil 'khor klong du rjes 'dzin pa'i// drin chen bla ma'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// yongs rdzogs bla ma'i sa mchog dngos grub stsol// snang srid dag pa lha yi dkyil 'khor du// bla med ye shes 'dus pa'i he ru ka

/che mchog drag po rtsal la gsol ba 'debs// phun tshogs grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub stsol// pad+mas legs nyes mtshan mar bka' bsgos pa// tshul bzhin sgrub la lus dang grib ltar 'grog /zab gter srung ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// ci 'dod sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen dngos grub stsol//

zhes pa 'di yang lcags mdud phyogs kyi skal ldan rin chen rdo rjes thal mo sbyar nas rin chen gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phul nas zhus pa'i ngor/ yi dam yongs rdzogs 'dus pa pad+ma drag po rtsal gyi brgyud pa rin po che'i bcud blang ba'i gsol 'debs te klong gsal snying pos sbyar ba'o// maṅga laṃ// //
